name: Net points differential
notes: Core skill input to every model line

name: Pythagorean luck index
description: Actual wins minus expected wins from scoring differential
direction: Positive = winning more than scoring implies
computation: exp2.37 expectation vs W-L-T; parameter is model choice
notes: Used to fade lucky teams (STR-D6); DEN +2.17 / TB -2.17 after wk9

name: Starter deficiency load
description: Sum of severity weights for starters on official injury report
official_source: Official injury report x official club depth charts
computation: Out=1.0 Questionable=0.25 DNP=0.5 Limited=0.0 capped 3.0 per team

name: QB1 availability flag
description: Official chart QB1 appears on injury report or is ruled out
official_source: Official depth chart x official injury report
computation: Join chart QB1 against report designations
notes: Murray/Wentz (MIN), Darnold (SEA), Wilson (GB chart shows Love1) flagged for starter confirmation Q03/Q04

name: Replacement chain depth
description: Effective next-man-up string level after skipping Out players
official_source: Official depth chart columns + official Out status
notes: NE RB resolves Stevenson->Out Henderson->3rd Kiner

name: No-listed-backup flag
description: Starter's depth-chart cell has no backup listed
computation: second cell empty on starter row
notes: 10 positions incl. PIT Watt/Heyward, SF LCB Green

name: Rest and travel asymmetry
description: Short week or international travel before kickoff
computation: Munich intl game wk10; byes wk10: CHI DEN PHI TB
notes: NE/DET both travel to Munich (symmetric for that game)

name: Home-field advantage
description: Fixed 2.0 points for home teams; 0 at neutral sites
